page_title: FRE 3-1 AUG | Freiburg v Augsburg 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Bastian Dankert is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) sends the corner into the box, but Nediljko Labrovic intercepts it and averts the threat.
89' Mert Komur (Augsburg) picked up a yellow card from referee.
87' The game has come to an end for Christian Gunter. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
85' Here is a change. Frank Onyeka is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Steve Mounie (Augsburg).

84' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Augsburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' The attendance for today's match is 33500.
78' Substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj makes his way off the pitch and Mert Komur (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
76' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) replaces Vincenzo Grifo.
76' Substitution. Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) in, Ritsu Doan out.
72' The game is interrupted now, Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
71' Noah Atubolu pulls off a great save to deny Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
69' Surely that's handball by one of the Freiburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
67' Augsburg force their opponents to concede a corner.
65' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Eren Dinkci is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
65' The substitution has been made. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) has replaced Junior Adamu.
65' 3 - 1 Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.

60' Freiburg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
56' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Samuel Essende will be replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
51' Freiburg couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Nediljko Labrovic (Augsburg) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
50' 5:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
46' The game is over for Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg). Alexis Claude-Maurice comes on for the second half.
46' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) replacing Marius Wolf.
46' The whistle blows and Bastian Dankert starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

45+1' 3 - 0 Christian Gunter (Freiburg) didn't hesitate to slam the ball goalwards after he received a lofted pass from Ritsu Doan. Nediljko Labrovic probably underestimated his effort, as it went straight into the bottom right corner. The score changes to 3:0.
45+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Bastian Dankert blows for a foul after Junior Adamu (Freiburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
37' 2 - 0 Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the left side of the goal. The score is 2:0.
37' Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
34' 1 - 0 Goal! Eren Dinkci plays a short, square pass into the path of Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 1:0. Fabulous goal!
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
30' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
28' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

27' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Nediljko Labrovic was alert and made a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Freiburg.
25' Augsburg couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
24' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is punished with the yellow card.
24' An accurate cross picks out Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
20' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) brought his opponent down.
18' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Nediljko Labrovic is equal to it and makes an easy save.
17' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
15' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) picks up a long through ball, but Nediljko Labrovic deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

11' My Gran could have done better! Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
10' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
6' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

5' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Bastian Dankert no option but to blow his whistle. Freiburg have a free kick.
2' Freiburg fail to score from a corner as Nediljko Labrovic (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert was nominated as the referee for this game.
